ui.endgame.portal.help:
Echo Portal
ZONES: each zone has its Echo portal outside its biome, with one tier per Echo. GO takes you there. T1 opens when you defeat the zone boss; each completed Echo opens the next tier of that zone.
ECHOES: endgame maps that drop as loot from level 45. Each one has a tier (monsters level 50 to 80), a zone, a boss and modifiers that make it harder but add loot quantity and rarity. They open at their zone portal (this portal no longer opens Echoes); an Echo is consumed on entry, whether you complete it or not.
Crafting: Shard (new mods), Crystal (+1 mod), Prism (rarity), Time Anchor (+1 tier; drops only in Echoes).
ATLAS: a tree for your whole account. The first time you complete a tier, a zone or a boss you earn points. Resetting is free. In a group the host Atlas applies; everyone earns their own points.
+10% loot quantity for each extra player in the Echo.

ui.endgame.abyss.help:
Abyss Bosses
Extreme versions of 4 bosses (level 85–90) and a secret boss. Fragments: they drop in tier 10+ Echoes (higher tier, rarity and mods = better chance; an Echo whose boss matches gives more of that Fragment). 5 open their boss; they are consumed on entry.
A straight fight, no dungeon: phases, warnings of the next move and enrage if it drags on. Each player earns their own loot: the exclusive legendary is guaranteed the first time; Abyss Essences (forge).
The secret one requires defeating the 4 and 1 Fragment of each.
